title: dfilter: Add remaining arithmetic integer ops

notes.body:
What is the syntax for using MODULO (%) ?  
Is it possible to use it like this - [Is there any way to obtain every 2nd, 3th, 7th etc. packet?](https://ask.wireshark.org/question/25833/is-there-any-way-to-obtain-every-2nd-3th-7th-etc-packet/)

With some small tweaks it should be possible to use `frame.number % 3 == 0` for every third packet, etc.

Currently doesn't work but that's an oversight.
Thanks! I tested it as is but couldn't come up with a solution.
Sure! I appreciate you testing it. I'll push something later to address that use case.

commits_data.message:
safe-math: Fix non-existent built-ins

Divison and modulo are not built-ins implemented by GCC or Clang.

Replace the spurious macro definition with the internal implementation.
